prompt: 生成一张方形 4×4 表情包设计板，同一只奶油色小熊，圆耳、砖红领巾、粗棕线、白底。按每行从左到右：第一行挥手、大笑、点头、鼓掌；第二行疑惑、惊讶、害羞、委屈；第三行打哈欠、打瞌睡、抱心、加油；第四行抱歉、感谢、拒绝、再见。每格只有一个完整角色姿势，尺度一致、留足裁切空隙。无文字、网格线和水印。
promptEnglish: Create a square 4×4 sticker sheet for one cream-colored bear with round ears, a brick-red scarf and thick brown outlines on white. Left to right: row one waves, laughs, nods, applauds; row two looks puzzled, surprised, shy, sad; row three yawns, dozes, hugs a heart, cheers; row four apologizes, gives thanks, refuses, says goodbye. Keep each pose entirely within its own cell at a consistent scale, with room to crop. Use no text, gridlines or watermarks.
sourcePrompt: 请用16宫格设计角色的微信表情包。
